Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless tileable wall base-color texture for a torch-lit isometric fantasy dungeon game.
Primary request: one square 1024x1024 game-ready texture covering the whole image edge to edge. Cool neutral grey limestone with muted taupe mineral undertones, broad naturally eroded rock folds and irregular hairline fissures. Subtle pale calcite traces. No masonry.
Surface: A close orthographic face-on sample of continuous uncut natural cave bedrock, broad softly rounded eroded masses with irregular cracks and small chipped facets. Large mineral forms around 30-70cm with finer grain. It must read as a continuous cave rock surface, not separate piled stones or a stone wall.
Style/medium: believable tactile semi-realistic fantasy game material, coherent broad forms, restrained high-frequency noise.
Lighting: flat diffuse albedo illumination, no directional cast shadows, no baked torch light, no specular highlights, no vignette or central spotlight. Midtone color values so in-game lighting supplies the darkness.
Composition: strictly a flat 2D material swatch, no perspective, no scene or tunnel opening. Seamlessly wrap both horizontally and vertically, consistent detail scale and brightness at all four edges.
Avoid: text, borders, labels, split panels, grids, brickwork, cut blocks, mortar, grass, roots, water puddles, objects, crystals, black holes. Opaque RGB.
